node.statement: Let A=DF_+(0) on the real normed space iH and L=iR*J. By the preceding invariant-line computation A(L) subseteq L, so A induces bar-A on iH/L; by the definition of the quotient norm, ||bar-A+I||<=||A+I||<1. Under the quotient tangent identification and graph-coordinate identification above, bar-A is D-breve-sigma_{breve-e}; consequently ||D-breve-sigma_{breve-e}+I||<1 in the quotient norm.
